item.title: Cosy Train Sim 'Station To Station' Arrives On Switch 2 Later This Month

description.p: Choo choo.Do you like trains? Of course you do, who doesn't like trains. Stupid question. Anyway, you're in luck, dear reader. item.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Will Launch Earlier Than Expected On Switch 2

item.title: EU 'Digital Fairness Act' Could Have A Huge Impact On Loot Boxes And Virtual Currency

description.p: A step in the right direction?After being leaked earlier this week, the European Commission has today presented its proposal for the 'Digital Fairness Act' — a rule update that aims to offer "better protection for consumers and fairer competition for businesses" in the games industry.To be clear, the proposal has not been adopted by the EU Commission just yet, but if it does go through, it could have a huge impact on several hot-topic game mechanics like loot boxes, virtual currencies, pay-to-win options and more. What's more, the act would apply to all EU member states without the need for individual approval.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: It's Official, Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Has Sold Over 5 Million Copies In 4 Days

description.p: It's the fastest-selling Switch 2 game.Nintendo has announced that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has sold a total of 5.2 million units in just four days.This number includes 810,000 copies sold in Japan alone, and makes Ocarina of Time the fastest-selling Nintendo-published Switch 2 game since the console's launch. For added context, the N64 original sold an overall total of 7.6 million units, according to Video Game Sales wiki.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
